facts.fact: Medias24's review of the 2026 draft finance bill puts the Ministry of Digital Transition's investment credits at 1,579 million dirhams, down 11.2% from 1,779 million in 2025; it says all ministries' operating budgets rise but gives no figure for this ministry.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transition budget, PLF 2026

note: Only investment credits are given for the ministry, so no rose or fell value is recorded.
